preconditions: A fresh, dedicated BLE benchmark database with safely repeatable initialization, never production or shared development data
A Laborleitung test user limited to the benchmark scope
Both referenced standards TL SoB-StB 20 and ETV-StB-BW available for linking
The target product STS 0–45 is absent before each measured creation run
setup: To be implemented and verified from Creynox/BLE in its own safe branch/worktree; do not let the blackbox executor seed or reset the database.
reset: Repeatable isolated fixture reset must be explicitly reviewed before execution; never reset ble-postgres on port 5433 without proving isolation and authorization.
independent_oracle: Authorized evaluator-side read-only verification of created product identity, mandatory fields and both standard links, inaccessible to UI executor.
